pass_a_gloss: Counsel of-poor you-shamed, because Lord hope of-him is. Through us for he-became-poor the Lord, rich being, in-order-that we by-the of-that-one poverty we-might-become-rich.
pass_b_english: “You shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his hope” (Psalm 13:6).
For on our account the Lord became poor, being rich, so that we by his poverty might become rich (2 Corinthians 8:9).

choices.term: δι’ ἡμᾶς γὰρ ἐπτώχευσεν ὁ Κύριος, πλούσιος ὤν
choices.english: for on our account the Lord became poor, being rich
choices.why: 2 Corinthians 8:9 applied to the poor whose hope is the Lord. Not ‘the Lord was always poor’.
rejected: we became poor so he might be rich
